name: Create Smoke
body:
School conjuration (creation); Level adept 0, bard 0, druid 0, inquisitor 0, shaman 0, sorcerer/wizard 0, summoner 0, witch 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 round
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect a column of smoke
Duration 1 minute
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

With a word and a gesture, you create a pillar of harmless smoke. The created smoke covers a single 5-ft. square and rises to 100 feet in windless conditions. It does not provide concealment. Moderate or stronger wind disperses the smoke immediately. The smoke is in any one color selected by you at the moment of casting.
